title: Don’t let static electricity cause a tragedy at the gas pump! If you ...
description: Don’t let static electricity cause a tragedy at the gas pump! If you get back in your car while fueling, touch the metal on your car first before touching the gas pump handle!  It is rare, but it can happen! And from what I’ve read, it’s when the person got back in the car while fueling, & they didn’t re-ground before touching the handle, which resulted in static electricity igniting the fumes from the gasoline.  #wintersafety #psa
